newsitem.title: QATAR: British defence secretary arrives in Qatar.
newsitem.headline: British defence secretary arrives in Qatar.

text.p: British Defence Secretary Michael Portillo arrived in Doha on Sunday to discuss ways to boost bilateral cooperation, the official news agency QNA said.
It gave no further details on the visit, his second to Doha in less than two weeks.
Portillo said after talks in Doha on October 28 he had offered a comprehensive Gulf security proposal to Qatar, a small peninsula on Saudi Arabia's Gulf coast.
Diplomats said the offer was part of a British bid to find a fresh foothold in Gulf states from where it voluntarily withdrew in 1971.
Britain is also trying to sell 50 main battle tanks to Qatar's 8,000-strong army in competition with similar efforts by France and the United States.

All three Western powers have defence treaties with Qatar, whose natural gas reserves -- the world's third largest after those of Russia and Iran -- make it one of the most strategic sources of vital clean energy in the next century.
